roles.title: Senior Rust Engineer (Solana programs)
roles.jobDescription:
Senior Rust Engineer (Solana programs)

We're a seed-stage DeFi startup in Warsaw building an on-chain credit marketplace on Solana: lenders and borrowers matched by programs, with no bank in the middle. The team is five people, led by our founder Hanna Lewicka, and we're hiring our second protocol engineer.

You'll design, ship and maintain our Anchor programs (lending pools, liquidations, fee splits), write the tests and fuzzing that keep them safe, and help build the TypeScript SDK our app uses.

What we need:
- 4+ years of production Rust
- Solana programs you shipped to mainnet (Anchor or native)
- Experience with DeFi protocols: a DEX, lending or AMM
- A security mindset: property tests, fuzzing, working with auditors
- Fluent English (C1); our investors and auditors are international

Nice to have: TypeScript SDKs for programs, open-source Solana work, early-stage experience.

Hybrid: 2 days a week in our Warsaw office. 30,000–38,000 PLN/month on B2B, plus tokens.

mustHave.label: Shipped Solana programs to mainnet (Anchor or native)
DeFi protocol experience (DEX, lending or AMM)
Program security: property tests, fuzzing, audits

niceToHave.label: TypeScript SDKs or clients for programs

dealBreakers.label: Only open to fully remote work

roles.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
roles.company: Pre-seed robotics and physical-security software startup, Zürich
roles.jobDescription: An early-stage startup builds the software layer that orchestrates cameras, sensors and autonomous robots for industrial sites and critical infrastructure. As a Forward Deployed Engineer you own customer deployments end to end: installing and debugging edge hardware on site, integrating video management systems and sensors, and turning technical pilots into production contracts. You sit between the core engineering team and the customer, so you need both deep debugging skills across hardware, network and models, and the calm to manage stakeholders when a pilot goes sideways. The role is based in Zürich with roughly half of the time spent at customer sites across Europe. German, defense or critical-infrastructure experience and a zero-to-one startup background are a plus.

mustHave.label: Deployed on-prem or edge hardware (e.g. Jetson-class GPUs)
Integrated cameras, sensors or robotics with software
Customer-facing deployment role (FDE, field or solutions engineer)

dealBreakers.label: Only internal-facing engineering, never on a customer site
Not willing to travel ~50% of the time

roles.title: Account Executive, DACH
roles.company: Growth-stage B2B SaaS for maintenance and facility management
roles.locationLabel: Kraków or Warsaw · hybrid, 2–3 days in office
roles.jobDescription: A fast-growing B2B SaaS company that recently added a mobile-first maintenance product is hiring a German-speaking Account Executive to own the DACH market for it. You run the full cycle: outbound prospecting, discovery-led demos, negotiation and closing, with your own quota, pipeline and forecast. Buyers are maintenance managers and operations leaders at manufacturing and facility-management companies. The team sits in Kraków and Warsaw and works hybrid. We want someone who treats sales as a process, has hit a quota in B2B SaaS and is comfortable building pipeline from scratch rather than waiting for inbound. Experience selling maintenance, facility or industrial software is a strong plus.

mustHave.label: Owned quota, pipeline and forecast end to end
Based in Kraków or Warsaw, hybrid

niceToHave.label: Sold maintenance, facility or industrial software
Sold to manufacturing or operations buyers

dealBreakers.label: Inbound or account management only, never built outbound pipeline

roles.title: Java Backend Engineer (Insurance platform)
roles.locationLabel: Kraków, Gdańsk, Łódź or Poznań · hybrid, 3 days in office
roles.jobDescription: An established vendor of policy and claims platforms for insurers is growing the team behind its financial and claims modules, which process millions of operations a month. You will design and build backend services and REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot, working with both document and relational databases, in a team that uses AI agents for specs, documentation and tests. The role starts backend-heavy and gradually grows into full-stack work with Angular, so openness to the frontend matters. Hybrid in one of four Polish offices. Docker and Elastic experience, insurance or claims domain knowledge and familiarity with DDD or event-driven design are welcome.

dealBreakers.label: Not open to 3 office days a week
Refuses to pick up Angular / frontend work
